answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each agent burns 20 POA to claim one work slot, valid for 10 epochs, like a flag on a knoll none else can claim. When a gale of fake signups hits, each clone must burn 20 POA too, so 1,000 clones cost 20,000 POA while one slot earns only 30 POA in fees, a guaranteed loss. Honest agents pay once, earn fees for 10 epochs and keep their slot; a random audit burns idle slots, so the market stays a steady zephyr of real work.
